hints.tr: `&` ilk çevrilmeli; sonra gelen karşılıkların içindeki `&`'ye dokunulmaz.
hints.en: `&` must be converted first; then the `&` inside later equivalents is not touched.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def escape_html(text):
    text = text.replace("&", "&")
    text = text.replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")
    return text.replace('"', """).replace("'", "'")

print(escape_html("a < b & c"))
print(escape_html("say \"hi\" or 'bye'"))
print(escape_html("<"))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def escape_html(text):
    text = text.replace("&", "&")
    text = text.replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")
    return text.replace('"', """).replace("'", "'")

print(escape_html("a < b & c"))
print(escape_html("say \"hi\" or 'bye'"))
print(escape_html("<"))
```
